text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Gaming Tax Act, 1972 Shorttitle
and shall apply throughout Malaysia.                      ariitentore,

2. (1) The Minister of Finance may by order published in Gaming tax.
the Gazette impose a gaming tax in respect of the amount

paid by any person as a bet or an investment in

respect of any gaming authorised under any law relating

to gaming for the time being in force.

(2) A gaming tax imposed under subsection (1) shall
be paid by the person making the bet or the investment
and shall be collected by the promoter of the gaming so
authorised and shall be paid into the revenue of the
Federation.

(3) The Minister of Finance may make regulations for
the purpose of carrying out or giving effect to the provisions

of this section.                                (Peet. Det 972/75) 7

VI. Betting and Sweepstake Duties Ordinance of Sabah
(Sabah Cap. 13)

Section 3 of the above Ordinance is hereby amended—

(a) by deleting the words "two and a half per centum of the amount
of the bet"  appearing in subsection (1) thereof and substituting
therefor the words "such per ccntum of the amount of the bet
as the Minister may from time to time fix by order published
in the Gazette"; and

(b) by deleting the words "seven and a half per centum of the
amount contributed towards such sweepstake" appearing in
sub-section (2) thereof and substituting therefor the words "such
per centum of the amount contributed towards such sweepstake
as the Minister may from time to time fix by order published
in the Gazette".

Section 8A of the above Ordinance is hereby repealed.

VII. Gambling Ordinance of Sarawak (Cap. 138)

Section 27 of the above Ordinance is hereby amended—

(a) by deleting the words "Governor in Council" appearing in line
one of subsection (1) thereof and substituting therefor the words

cent of" appearing in subsection (2) thereof and substituting
